title: OneCalendar
customer: Independent tour operators in Miami-Dade selling on 2 or more marketplaces
problem: They re-enter bookings by hand and risk double bookings.
solution: A booking sync that pulls every marketplace into one calendar and blocks sold slots everywhere.
valueProp: Hours saved every week and no double bookings.
revenueModel: SaaS subscription per operator per month.
openQuestions: Do the marketplaces allow this kind of sync? (to check)
Our only evidence of the friction is an AI answer with no source.
author: Diego
